title: One backend roundMoney owner and half-cent boundary guard

acceptanceCriteria.description: src/lib/money.ts#roundMoney is the only named backend cent-rounding owner; billing, markup, rate DTO, label-boundary, and dry-run planner call sites delegate to it instead of retaining local round2, roundCents, cents, or roundMoney implementations.

The canonical owner deterministically handles positive and negative x.xx5 ties, binary floating-point dust, non-finite input, and negative zero, while quote markup and invoice billing resolve to the same cents.
A reproducible same-fixture comparison between the exact pre-PS-457 commit and current stable emits byte-identical 304-byte billing export output with matching SHA-256 hashes.

Billing source-of-truth parity, detail export, read divergence, rate source-of-truth, protected dry-run planners, strict TypeScript, production web build, and all 56 mandatory source-of-truth commands pass offline.

The user supplied the exact shipped-data override and separately approved the PS-457 protected-path diff; the two shipment-history planners changed only their rounding delegate, their proof/idempotency/write gates remain intact, and no production mutation or provider effect occurred.
The closure packet is exact-SHA governed, rejects malformed or stale proof, adds no migration, and introduces no frontend or wrapper source of truth.

canonicalOwners: src/lib/money.ts#roundMoney owns the backend numeric dollar-to-cent boundary
src/services/shipping-workflow/markup-resolver.ts owns canonical markup calculation and delegates cent rounding
src/services/billing-shipping-line.ts owns billed shipping-line selection and delegates cent rounding
backend billing and rate services own persisted or customer-visible monetary DTOs; the frontend only renders backend facts

oldOwners.path: local roundMoney/round2/roundCents/cents helpers in billing, rate, DTO, label-boundary, and backfill modules
Shopify grams conversion helper formerly named roundMoney
oldOwners.delegatesTo: a unit-specific roundWeight helper that cannot be mistaken for money authority

wrappers.delegatesTo: src/lib/money.ts#roundMoney without changing dry-run, proof, idempotency, skip, or write policy

sotBypass.details: The change removes competing rounding implementations and points callers directly at the canonical backend owner. It adds no frontend business rule, compatibility fallback, alternate persistence path, or wrapper-owned money decision.

evidence.proves: The one owner implements symmetric half-cent behavior with scale-aware tolerance, quote/invoice parity, and a recursive scan that rejects competing named cent owners.

migrations.rollbackPlan: No schema rollback is needed. Preserve all existing additive migrations; if PS-457 must be reversed, use a reviewed forward revert of its call-site delegation commit and the two documentation-only closure commits.

rollback.strategy: Forward-revert the bounded PS-457 delegation commit and its evidence/packet commits. Do not alter existing billing, shipment, order, rate-proof, or migration history, and never run either historical backfill apply path as part of rollback.

liveVerification.reason: The reviewed runtime implementation is already present on stable and this closeout adds documentation only. Live billing, label, provider, or shipment verification would create avoidable money/data side-effect risk; all acceptance proof is deterministic and offline.
